"""Visual-only door-unlock attempt for eai-standard/2.1.

The controller uses only camera images, camera calibration, proprioception,
and task.target_pos. The scene inspection suggested the gray lock slider was
left of target_pos along world x, so the final approach pushes it in +x.
"""
import sys
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot


def run():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    dt = spec["control_dt"]
    cameras = ["front", "left", "right", "topview"]

    # Read the allowed RGB-D views, calibration, target, and robot state.
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    target = np.asarray(obs.meta["task"]["target_pos"], dtype=float)
    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    state = dict(zip(layout, obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
    mocap = np.array([state["mocap_x"], state["mocap_y"], state["mocap_z"]])

    def move_to(point, grip=-1.0, note="visual approach"):
        nonlocal mocap
        point = np.asarray(point, dtype=float)
        delta = point - mocap
        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / 0.01)))
        rows = np.zeros((n, 4), dtype=float)
        rows[:, :3] = delta / (n * 0.01)
        rows[:, 3] = grip
        result = robot.submit(
            "ee_delta", rows, dt=dt, cameras=cameras,
            video="frames", include_depth=True, note=note,
        )
        mocap = point
        return result

    # Lift clear, view the cabinet and align just left of the apparent slider.
    move_to([mocap[0], mocap[1], 0.34], note="lift for camera view")
    approach = [float(target[0] - 0.17), float(target[1] - 0.02), 0.34]
    move_to(approach, note="approach slider from its left side")

    contact = [approach[0], approach[1], float(target[2] + 0.02)]
    move_to(contact, note="set contact height from depth view")
    push = [float(target[0] + 0.10), contact[1], contact[2]]
    result = move_to(push, grip=-1.0, note="push lock slider toward target")
    result.save("/app/output/gen_run")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
